lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized into vertical columns; the region posterior to the gills features columns of 3 to 5 nodes that align with horizontal rows across the mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming anchor points that create a structural grid pattern across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges exhibit sharp vertical luminance gradients; the primary medial ridge maintains a high-contrast transition from superior highlight to inferior shadow along the upper lateral flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance circular nodes; approximately five distinct spots are visible, concentrated primarily along the posterior margin and lower half of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular indentations and pixel-level discontinuities are visible along the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin, indicating minor structural trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The upper lobe of the caudal fin displays a dense, stochastic distribution of small high-luminance spots that decrease in size and increase in spatial frequency toward the distal tip.
